title: Custom American Football with Paint Splash Background Vintage Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom space with the custom sports-themed bedding set from Jeminise. This custom bedding features a vintage football design with a football player flag pattern, offering a soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth that is perfect for football players, fans, and sports lovers.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customization options support up to 2 text inputs for personalized name and number.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Lightweight & Durable: Lightweight material with smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges for lasting durability.
  • Included Components: Package includes 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, air dry without heat, or tumble dry on low heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Vintage Football Player Flag
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Pattern Football Player Flag Pattern
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
Available Sizes Full, King, Queen, Twin
